one_line: Master grammarian of Gandhāra whose Ashtādhyāyī codified Sanskrit in the mid-4th century BCE.

appearance.face: oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium wheatish Gandhāran complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused eyes with a slight upward tilt, default expression thoughtful with a faint, knowing half-smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a short, tidy topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothly pulled back; simple narrow off-white cloth headband wrapped once around the forehead, knotted at the back with small tails
appearance.costume: a knee-length, sleeved chiton-like inner tunic in undyed off-white linen, belted at the waist with a plain dark brown leather girdle; over it, a Gandhāran-style woolen mantle (shawl) in muted indigo blue draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the back, forming layered folds; lower body covered by a straight, ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti-style wrap, clean pleats in front; simple dark brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery: a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small round copper studs in the ears, emphasizing modest scholarly status rather than opulence
appearance.signature: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bound with a red cord held in his left hand, with a smooth dark wooden writing stylus tucked under the cord, treated as the physical emblem of the Ashtādhyāyī

ref_desc: Pāṇini is a lean mid-30s Gandhāran scholar with an oval wheatish face, short beard, black topknot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white tunic and dhoti with an indigo mantle, leather belt and sandals, copper accents, holding a bound palm-leaf manuscript with stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style model sheet of Pāṇini of Śālātura: a lean man in his mid-30s with an oval wheatish Gandhāran face, sharp cheekbones, straight nose, calm focused eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his thick black hair tied into a small tidy topknot at the back of the crown, framed by a narrow off-white cloth headband wrapped around his forehead and knotted at the back. He wears a knee-length, sleeved off-white linen tunic belted with a plain dark brown leather girdle, an ankle-length off-white dhoti-style wrap with neat front pleats, and a muted indigo blue woolen mantle draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back in clear layered folds. On his feet are simple dark brown leather sandals; his only ornaments are a thin copper bangle on his right wrist and small round copper ear studs. In his left hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bound with a muted red cord, with a smooth dark wooden writing stylus tucked under the cord, and his default expression is quietly thoughtful with a faint half-smile. Show him front, side, and three-quarter views in consistent colours—off-white, indigo blue, dark brown, muted red, and copper—clearly revealing his face, headband and topknot, draped mantle, tunic, dhoti, sandals, and the manuscript with stylus as his signature prop.
